extracted.name: Cinnamon pancakes
extracted.description: This was made when i was bored and just wanted to add sonething else to it. My sibilings like there pancakes with jam or peanut butter. If you have any left iver youu can chill them and in the morning you can heat them back up!!
instruction_lines: Mix the flour, baking soda, salt, and sugar.
Make a well shape with your flour mixer and add the milk (add like 2 cups of the milk then dave ut for later just in case if the batter is to runny) add eggs and melted butter. Mix untill combined.
When mixed if the batter is still thick add more milk or ifbthe batter is to runny add more flour. Then add the cinnamin and mix just untill combined.
Spread butter on a pan or griddle and pour batter about 1/3 of a cup for each pancake and cook on both sides. Serve hot!!
